harness_repair.diagnosis: This container's checkout never ran scripts/setup_dev_env.sh, so node_modules/@agentv/core was absent. The evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crash this produces (RuntimeError: AgentV SDK is unavailable) is the same infra failure documented in docs/design/autotrain-cycle-c2-agentv-missing-infra-failure.md; the NODE_OPTIONS/sanitized_node_env repair from commit 72fdffaf054efee2f3dccc4bab0ca97c111072e1 was already in the codebase and did not need to change. The repeat cost a full wall-capped cycle (both arms trained to completion, then both failed identically at eval) because nothing checked for the SDK before spending the budget.
harness_repair.fix_summary: Ran scripts/setup_dev_env.sh's steps (python3.12 venv + editable install + `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci`) to restore the missing node_modules/@agentv/core in this container, then added a preflight guard so the next occurrence fails in <1s instead of burning a cycle: scripts/run_autotrain_continuous.py:missing_dev_env_prerequisites() checks node_modules/@agentv/core across checkout_roots() before acquiring the driver lock and exits 2 with `DEV_ENV_PREREQUISITES_MISSING agentv_sdk; run scripts/setup_dev_env.sh` when absent.

next_priority: replay identical frozen arm (retry_measurement) now that the AgentV SDK is installed and the preflight guard confirms it before spending cycle budget
